prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good morning. This is the adjuster following up on the claim you reported. This recorded statement is for claim file purposes. Do you understand and consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand and I consent.

Q: Thank you. Please tell me in your own words what happened on the day of the collision.

A: I was driving in the right lane on the main road in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward the freeway on-ramp. I wanted to move into the left lane to get ready for my exit. I checked my mirror, saw nothing close, and signaled. As I started to merge, the other car came up quickly in that lane and its side scraped mine.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: Not clearly. I glanced at my mirror and didn't see it, but I think it may have been in my blind spot or coming up fast behind a truck.

Q: Were you able to stop or steer away after contact?

A: I pulled to the shoulder right away. My car kept drifting for a second, and I hit the brakes hard.

Q: You mentioned an injury. Can you describe it?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard when we made contact. It swelled up pretty fast, and it hurts when I bend it or put weight on it. I went to urgent care that same afternoon.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment or taking any medication for the knee?

A: I'm seeing a physical therapist twice a week, and I take over-the-counter pain relievers when it gets bad.

Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle at the time?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. Thank you for calling.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
